description: A value-position block arm that holds a statement yields only by `lift`: in `.B :> { one(); 2; }` the bare `2` after the statement is E-ARM-TAIL-VALUE (once), not the arm's value. Every statement has its `;`, so no termination code is involved.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — block arms yield with `lift`" — "Block arms yield with lift (Recommended)" · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — `{ e }` in a value-position match arm is that expression" — "Allow { e } in arms too (Recommended)" ("`lift` is required once the block holds a statement, and a bare tail after a statement is E-ARM-TAIL-VALUE") · S474 #1722 review F3
rationale: §18.5 (S469 r5): once the arm's block holds a statement, a bare expression after it SHALL be E-ARM-TAIL-VALUE in a value position; the fix-it is `lift 2;`. The one-expression brace `{ 2 }` / `{ 2; }` is not this code. impl#1 never emits E-ARM-TAIL-VALUE and yields `2` (the pre-S469 reading) — carried, g-impl1-arm-tail-value-unemitted-s474; the bootstrap emits it.
